benefits.text:
BBIA Ready To Wear Downy Cheek is an easy-to-use cream blush with a soft, smooth cashmere cream texture containing fine blurring powder that helps the color blend smoothly and adhere lightly to the skin. It creates a soft flushed-cheek effect like a thin blurring veil, helping cheeks look fresher, smoother and more natural through a makeup effect. The cream cheek formula feels lightweight, blends easily and suits everyday makeup. The blush colors were developed around a fresh, sweet apple mood, helping the face look livelier without looking heavy on color. The product file highlights the zero-darkening effect, which helps limit the blush turning deep red or darker over time.

Apple Edition is an S/S collection inspired by Green Apple and Red Apple. For Downy Cheek, the collection's spirit comes through in a fresh-apple flushed-cheek effect: one side soft, fresh and clear; the other sweeter, more radiant and more eye-catching.

safety.text:
For external use on the cheeks only; avoid use on scratched or irritated skin
Discontinue use if any unusual signs appear, and keep out of reach of children.

howToUse.text:
Use your fingertips or a makeup brush to pick up an appropriate amount of product.
Apply gently to the cheekbones, from the center of the cheek outward, and blend evenly for a natural color effect.
Depending on the makeup look you want, you can adjust the amount of product to get a suitably fresh, bright color.

positioning.text: A lightweight cream blush in a natural milky pink that helps cheeks look fresher while staying soft for everyday wear.

sellingPoints.text: Lightweight cream texture; natural color that lasts all day long; helps cheeks look softer and smoother.

texture.text: Lightweight, soft and smooth cheek cream, easy to blend.

finish.text: Natural smooth / light watercolor / fresh cheek.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say “non-irritating” in absolute terms. Skin irritation testing does not mean it is 100% suitable for every skin type.
